//: The last rewrite sends every route to the static maintenance page, so the
React bundle is never requested: no Firebase SDK download, no auth
listener, no Firestore connection. Nobody can sign in because the code
that signs people in is never served.
Rewrites match in order, first one wins, and Vercel serves real files from
the filesystem before any rewrite is considered -- so /assets/* and
/seed/* keep working without needing an exemption here.
TO GO LIVE AGAIN: delete the maintenance rewrite (the last one) and the
two passthroughs above it, leaving only the SPA fallback:
/privacy and /terms stay reachable because they are matched first. They
are static, they touch no data, and a privacy policy that disappears
during maintenance is the one page you cannot take down.
